rules: Catch-up: a SEC0 close above every one of the prior 250 fills each unfilled tranche whose gates are clear. Rates absorbed: a rates family that fails reads n/a (out of the count, never met) when DFII10 made a new 60-close high within the last 20 SEC0 closes while SEC0 rose over them.

The episode box holds every tranche when a coincident and a lead cluster both vote (a strict majority of their live members — see Episode gates), or when a capex_guides sign row blocks; every other BLOCK (dram_contract, taiwan_export …) is shown and holds nothing; below quorum (70 % of members live) T2/T3 hold too. A gate on an unread feed reads n/a and holds; the close decides.

The drawdown watch votes only on its graded table's rows with no role tag (that table names each row's role), with or without a drawdown open; a `confirmer` row lifts ELEVATED to HIGH only while a lead votes, a `step` row (SEC0 stretch) never votes but its hit lets an open drawdown step ELEVATED to HIGH, `context` rows sit in their own table and never touch the grade, and capex_guides, dram_contract, hbm, ai_funding, sox_breadth, taiwan_export and pc_demand show their lean and never grade. In an open drawdown, ELEVATED steps to HIGH only past the latch depth or the stretch entry depth — a bounce above the latch depth reads ELEVATED again, while a stretch step holds until a bounce above its shallower hold depth. A grade is notify-only — it holds no tranche and sells nothing by itself.

situation.lean: HIGH: the drawdown watch has eased one grade, but the leg still sits far below its October high with chip leadership broken and every slice still shut, so the holder stays out of the whole leg. Memory makers remain sold out and Nvidia's guide steadies the AI-spend story, yet re-entry waits on rates and credit easing plus a first 2027 spend figure from the big cloud buyers.
situation.slow: The grind is rates: real yields sit just under the bear line after the latest inflation-protected auction cleared at its highest yield in over two decades, keeping a December hike in play. Beneath that, costly memory keeps shrinking PC and phone demand, with AMD and Intel planning for another down year in 2027 while memory makers stay sold out.
situation.fast: Nvidia's strong guide removed the nearest gap, though its lower margin guide and its reliance on a few giant buyers leave headline risk, and banks dumping Oracle-linked data-centre loans below face value show AI funding strain building. The next gaps are a tighter US curb on China chip access riding the defense bill and a sudden yen jump around the Bank of Japan meeting.
situation.decides: The 12-09 FOMC moves the slow threat, a second hike raising it and a hold calming it, and the 12-10 inflation print sets the path beyond it; Broadcom on 12-09 and the defense bill by the 12-11 funding deadline move the fast threat, a strong AI guide and a bill free of chip curbs calming it. Micron on 12-17 moves the slow threat, a margin below its guide raising it and a higher next-quarter guide calming it, while the 12-18 Bank of Japan meeting moves the fast threat through the yen.
situation.flips: A chip-export curb in the defense bill, a big cloud buyer's first 2027 spend figure at or below a tenth above this year, or a Broadcom or Micron guide below the street moves the lean to bear; a policy curb landing alongside a Fed hike is the crash-speed case. Rates and credit easing together with raised 2027 spend at two of the four big buyers would let the shut slices reopen.
